newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine fugitive MP in custody-radio.
newsitem.headline: Philippine fugitive MP in custody-radio.

text.p: Philippine authorities have taken into custody a legislator who has been on the run for more than three weeks after being charged with the statutory rape of an 11-year old girl, a Manila private radio station said on Friday.
Station DZRH said Congressman Romeo Jalosjos was in the custody of the chief of the Presidential Security Group.
The report could not immediately be confirmed.
A Manila court has issued separate arrest warrants against Jalosjos for two counts of statutory rape and 12 acts of lasciviousness.
